feishu_table_boundary.principle: Feishu Base stores business indexes, relationship facts, and historical metric snapshots only. Evidence, run logs, render artifacts, LLM intermediate JSON, output variants, and long documents are stored in media_vault, Hyperframe render output, or Feishu Docx documents.

non_feishu_objects.reason: Evidence is file-like, high-cardinality, and must remain machine-readable without polluting visible Feishu tables.

non_feishu_objects.destination: media_vault + Feishu Docx via existing creation writers
non_feishu_objects.reason: Draft variants are long render outputs, not business index rows.
Findings are narrative review sections, not a separate Feishu table in v2.
Quote history remains artifact-backed until pricing history becomes a high-frequency query surface.
Render output is a view artifact, not a business fact.
Visible JSON fields are forbidden in main Feishu business tables.

platform_name.unit_policy: platform display name, not option id

attachment_reuse_policy.behavior: Before every canonical SourceAsset upsert, inherit existing structured attachment file_tokens from a same-platform normalized-source-url row. Duplicate rows reuse the canonical tokens and never re-upload the same media. Explicit attachment correction uses direct record update plus readback.

source_asset_id.description: Optional Media Growth SourceAsset artifact id from 【素材】 handoff. This links local media_vault/source_assets runs to the Feishu 02A row and does not replace asset_id.

original_title.snapshot_policy: captured from original platform at collection time

platform_hashtags.description: Hashtags explicitly supplied by the source platform or explicitly present as #话题 in captured original source text. Values are normalized without the leading # and must not contain AI classifications, tracks, creator labels, or publishing-package tags.

cover_attachment.description: Original-link cover image uploaded to the canonical SourceAsset Bitable row. Python owns upload, idempotent attachment-token writes, and readback.

video_attachment.description: Original-link video uploaded to the canonical SourceAsset Bitable row. Python owns upload, idempotent attachment-token writes, and readback.

source_doc_link.description: Human-facing Feishu document for original source asset context; full evidence remains in media_vault.

source_asset_id.description: Optional Media Growth SourceAsset artifact id from 【素材】 handoff; used only for lineage back to media_vault/source_assets when asset_id was generated from platform/url.

analysis_scope.description: Lightweight index of the deconstruction range. Long request constraints remain in media_vault artifact.

analysis_time_range.description: Human-readable time slice such as 0-5s. Use 历史未标注 for backfilled records that cannot prove the original scope.

deconstruction_focus.description: Lightweight index of what this deconstruction focused on; detailed output belongs in the artifact.

output_types.description: Lightweight index of requested output shape. Creation outputs are handed to creation workflows; long text is not stored in 02B.

shot_adaptation_notes_status.description: Status of the canonical shot_adaptation_notes structure in the deconstruction artifact; full structure remains in media_vault.

shot_adaptation_note_count.description: Number of validated shot_adaptation_notes in the deconstruction artifact.

recommended_production_route.description: Recommended route from reference_production_summary; does not replace the artifact.

motion_type_summary.description: Compact count summary of shot_adaptation_notes.motion_type values.

shot_adaptation_notes_summary.description: Human-readable compact summary of shot_adaptation_notes for Bitable scanning; full JSON stays in media_vault artifact.

reference_shots_status.description: Status of the source reference_shots index retained for Feishu scanning; full reference_shots stay in the canonical media_vault artifact.

reference_shot_count.description: Number of source reference_shots retained as a lightweight Feishu index.

reference_shots_summary.description: Human-readable compact source reference_shots summary for Bitable scanning; full structure remains in media_vault.

cover_opening_hook.description: Short LLM conclusion explaining why the cover, first image, first pages, or video first two seconds can make users stop. For image_post assets, video first-two/first-five-second fields are not applicable and must be replaced by image cover/page-order/text/caption evidence. Raw frames/images stay in evidence artifacts.

core_data_summary.description: Short LLM conclusion from engagement evidence such as likes, saves, comments, shares, publish time, and screenshot/OCR status.

top_comment_insight.description: Short LLM conclusion from exactly-three top-comment evidence when available; raw comment text stays in evidence artifacts.

target_audience_summary.description: Human-scannable audience summary distilled from deconstruction.v2 target_audience.

pain_pleasure_summary.description: Human-scannable pain/pleasure summary distilled from audience, comment, and engagement evidence.

attention_elements.description: Attention-grabbing elements such as title, cover, visual contrast, first-screen text, or comment-triggering framing.

viral_breakdown.description: Independent human-readable breakdown of why the source content may spread; does not replace full viral_mechanism artifact.

viral_migration.description: Short migration strategy for applying the useful structure to the user's account and context.

creative_upgrade_suggestion.description: Positive creative upgrade answer to: 千万年薪编导会怎么把这条改出彩？

deconstruction_doc_link.description: Human-facing Feishu document for this material deconstruction; full machine evidence remains in media_vault.

platform.description: Platform where the reusable pattern applies; lightweight index only.

content_type.description: Content type where the reusable pattern applies; lightweight index only.

applicable_persona.description: Narrative persona or audience group reference. Full insight card body stays in Obsidian.

applicable_scenarios.description: Reusable scenarios where the pattern can be applied.

opening_template.description: Validated opening hook template for creation retrieval; not a long card body.

structure_template.description: Compact structure template for creation retrieval.

visual_template.description: Compact visual template for creation retrieval.

emotional_levers.description: Controlled emotional levers or mechanism tags; full evidence stays in cards/artifacts.

forbidden_scenarios.description: Risk, platform compliance, or audience backlash boundaries.

promotion_rules.candidate_pattern->validated_pattern: manual confirmation or multiple supporting SourceAsset records

input_summary.description: Human-readable creation topic only. Platform, content type, and track are stored in their dedicated fields.

source_asset_id.description: Optional Media Growth SourceAsset artifact id carried by SourceAsset-first handoff into existing creation/shooting chains.

TrackRegistry.inference_policy: Track rows are explicit registered facts. Runtime code must not infer or synthesize tracks from H03 summaries, tags, profile descriptions, or similarity.

TrackCreatorMembership.inference_policy: Membership is an explicit persisted relation confirmed by a user, capability output, or reviewed source fact. Runtime code must not infer membership from tags, profile descriptions, H03 summaries, or similarity.

must_not_write: creator identity fields owned by CreatorProfile

lineage_policy.llm_failure_policy: If LLM output is missing, invalid, or insufficiently evidenced, writers may only persist pending/manual engineering status and artifact error reports; they must not write semantic business conclusions.

feishu_document_landing.policy: Reuse existing Feishu Docx landing capabilities. Hyperframe render_spec is an input artifact and must not introduce a parallel Markdown-to-Feishu writer.
forbidden: business routers hand-build Markdown documents for Feishu landing
Markdown pipe tables as final storyboard tables
new direct docx append path bypassing FeishuDocxBlockRenderer/create_creation_doc/CreationFeishuDocumentWriter

allowed_locations: migration/readback scripts that mark fields retired

forbidden_terms: read old JSON when new field empty
